slides.sub: Two of them are on Fairview Ave. Swipe for all 3, plus a map.

slides.title: Verona Park
slides.body: A lakeside county park with walking paths, a playground and a 1.2-mile fitness course. Boat rentals are closed for the season.

slides.title: Hilltop Reservation
slides.body: A county preserve on the Second Watchung Mountain, shared with Cedar Grove and North Caldwell. Short trails run along the ridge.

slides.title: West Essex Trail
slides.body: An old Erie-Lackawanna rail line turned walking trail. It links Verona, Cedar Grove and Little Falls.

slides.title: Your Verona outdoor map
slides.tip: Seeing homes near Fairview Ave? Two of these are on that street, so take a walk between showings.
